answer: An auditor observes each vault district pricing one thread licence per identity at 130 POA, burned at registration and anchored to a secure-element key that cannot be re-keyed. Enforcement is protocol-level: a licence only earns while its pulse attestation passes the epoch re-challenge, and a failed check suspends payouts until the licence is re-examined. A farm running k identities must burn k licences, hold k uncloneable keys and pass k live checks per epoch, so marginal cost stays linear in n, and every failure is recorded as an on-ledger slashing open to audit.
